harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the four-node Prometheus/Thanos stack. Both Prometheus replicas collect all four hosts, Thanos deduplicates queries on node3:10902, historical object-store queries work during either replica outage, and every node passed sequential restart-persistence testing.
actions_performed: Configured independent Prometheus replicas and Thanos sidecars on node1 and node2.
Enabled host metric exporters across all four nodes.
Configured Thanos query, store gateway, and compactor on node3.
Deployed authenticated TLS MinIO storage on node4 with persistent data under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
Generated credentials on node4 and placed protected access variables in /root/thanos-objectstore.env on node3.
Tested both Prometheus replica outage directions and restored each before proceeding.
Restarted node1 through node4 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collect all four hosts
evidence.summary: Both replicas are active and ready, each reports exactly four healthy node targets, and both sidecars upload without failures.

evidence.requirement: Thanos query, store, and compaction services on node3
evidence.summary: Query listens on node3:10902; query/store/compactor are active, ten object-store blocks are loaded, and the compactor has completed four iterations without halting.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store on node4 with persistent bucket data
evidence.summary: Authenticated bucket operations succeed, anonymous access returns 403, TLS covers node4 and its managed IP, and block data persists beneath /srv/thanos-objectstore.

evidence.requirement: Protected object-store access variables on node3
evidence.summary: /root/thanos-objectstore.env persists with mode 600 and the required variable names; secret values were not exposed.
Deduplication reduces eight replica series to four host series. A store-only query returned historical node4 data, and history remained queryable after the object-store restart.
Node1's replica stack was stopped; node3 remained ready and returned current and historical results. Node1 then recovered and rejoined cleanly.
Node2's replica stack was stopped; node3 remained ready and returned current and historical results. Node2 then recovered and rejoined cleanly.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, restored services/data, four healthy targets, and clean Thanos membership.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, restored services/data, four healthy targets, and clean Thanos membership.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery of query, store, compactor, credentials, memberships, and historical data.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, restored MinIO/TLS/authentication, persistent bucket objects, and successful downstream store resynchronization.
